name: esg-csrd-sfdr
display_name: ESG — CSRD, SFDR, EU Taxonomy & CSDDD
description: Structured knowledge graph for EU ESG regulatory framework: Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD/Directive 2022/2464), Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation (SFDR/Regulation 2019/2088), EU Taxonomy Regulation (2020/852), and Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive (CSDDD/Directive 2024/1760). Covers disclosure obligations, taxonomy alignment, double materiality, and value-chain due diligence.
author: Futurechain FCP Team
